text: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F of a group have different heights. One person is in between A and B. D is taller than F. A is taller than F. Two persons are in between A and E. One person is in between C and F. E is taller than D. Who among the following is the fifth tallest?
explanation: From the tallest to the shortest the order is E, D, C, A, F, B. F is number 5 counting from the tallest.

explanation: From the tallest to the shortest the order is E, D, C, A, F, B. The person just after D in height order is C.
